electric-clash-2026.name: Electric Clash 2026
electric-clash-2026.location: 6900 Airport Rd, Mississauga, ON L4V 1N2, Canada
electric-clash-2026.description:
Electric Clash 2026 expands Incendium's flagship fighting game tournament into a two day event, partnering with Video Game Live Expo to bring competitive play to The International Centre. The expanded program features four main tournament titles, with Street Fighter 6 joining established circuit events and a new Marvel fighting game in the lineup.

The Street Fighter 6 singles bracket uses a double elimination format on PC. Matches are best of three through the early rounds, moving to best of five for Top 8. Players must register for at least one of the featured game tournaments to compete, with a separate entry fee for each game.

Featured Tournaments and Convention Access

The other main brackets include Guilty Gear -Strive-, designated an Arc World Tour 2026-2027 Gold Event, TEKKEN 8, a 2026 Tekken World Tour Challenger Event, and Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls. All four tournaments use double elimination, with game specific match formats. TEKKEN 8 also has a separately announced prize bonus from Bandai Namco Esports. Registration passes include access to the wider VGLX convention, and the event offers food options nearby and free parking.

crossover-2026-1.name: CROSSOVER 2026
crossover-2026-1.description:
CROSSOVER 2026 marks the fifth annual edition of Germany's largest grassroots fighting game tournament, returning to its 2023 home near Cologne after a two-year Oberhausen run that drew 457 attendees in 2025. Grown from a 2022 regional pilot into a European calendar fixture, the weekend centers on Street Fighter 6.

Operating outside the Capcom Pro Tour, the Street Fighter 6 bracket runs as an open double-elimination contest using a first-to-three match format throughout. Regional prestige and a crowd-funded pot built from entry fees drive the stakes.

Multi-Game Lineup and Format

Seven titles share two stages. International circuit play anchors the broader roster, with Guilty Gear -Strive- serving as an ARC World Tour 2026-2027 Gold qualifier and Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising designated as a GBVS World Tour 2026 4-Star stop. Additional brackets feature TEKKEN 8, TEKKEN 7, MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, and Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game. Competitors register in advance on start.gg, while spectator passes are sold at the door and entrants under 18 require signed parental consent at check-in.

headstomper-2026.name: Headstomper 2026
headstomper-2026.description:
Founded in 2015 by the Copenhagen and Malmö fighting game communities under the Co-Ma FGC banner, Headstomper 2026 marks the eighth offline edition of Scandinavia's flagship tournament. Returning to its longtime hotel venue one train stop from Copenhagen Airport, the event follows a 2025 installment that drew 526 attendees and 116 Street Fighter 6 competitors.

The Street Fighter 6 tournament runs as an independent double-elimination main event on PlayStation 5. Each entrant's €10 game fee builds the prize pot, which is distributed to the top four finishers on a 50/25/15/10 percent split.

Tournament Lineup and Registration

Three co-headlining titles carry global circuit designations: Tekken 8 as a Tekken World Tour 2026 Challenger stop with a $2,000 pot bonus, Guilty Gear: Strive as an Arc World Tour 2026-2027 Gold tournament, and Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising as a GBVS World Tour 4-Star event, alongside MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Free side brackets feature 2XKO, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, Guilty Gear Xrd REV 2, BlazBlue: Central Fiction, Granblue Fantasy: Versus, and Rivals of Aether II. Competitor Passes require advance start.gg registration by October 31, while Spectator Passes remain available onsite.

socal-knockout-2026.name: SoCal Knockout 2026
socal-knockout-2026.description:
SoCal Knockout 2026 marks the inaugural edition of a collaborative grassroots regional, bringing Northern and Southern California organizing communities together for a dedicated weekend of open-bracket competition. Set at the Riverside Game Lab, the debut gathering establishes a unified proving ground for West Coast talent, centering Street Fighter 6 as the anchor of the inter-regional showdown.

The tournament provides crucial regional seeding weight and head-to-head prestige for competitors looking to solidify their standing across the West Coast scene. Players navigate a standard double-elimination structure built to test character mastery and matchup depth in a high-stakes bracket environment.

Additional Tournament Brackets

Beyond the primary bracket, the weekend hosts an extensive lineup of competitive fighting games, including TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, and legacy anime brackets such as BlazBlue: Central Fiction.

tgu-2026.name: Thaiger Uppercut Championship 2026
tgu-2026.location: The Portal Lifestyle Complex Building, 4th Floor, Popular 1 Rd, Banmai, Pak Kret District, Nonthaburi 11120, Thailand
tgu-2026.venueName: The Portal Ballroom, IMPACT Muang Thong Thani
tgu-2026.description:
Entering its 14th year, Thaiger Uppercut Championship 2026 (TGU) continues one of Thailand's longest running annual fighting game tournament traditions. The three day event brings international competition to the Bangkok metropolitan area, with Street Fighter 6 anchoring a broad lineup of fighting games, community tournaments, and activities beyond the main brackets. Returning to The Portal Ballroom at IMPACT Muang Thong Thani, TGU combines established competitive tournaments with opportunities for players and spectators to engage with Thailand's fighting game community.

The Street Fighter 6 competition features both singles and 3v3 team tournaments, giving competitors two distinct formats across the weekend. The main singles bracket is scheduled for Saturday, while the team competition takes place Friday under a last player standing format with first to one game matches and a first to two game grand final. The event also includes a women only Street Fighter 6 and TEKKEN 8 competition through Queens Clash. Unlike several other main tournaments on the schedule, the Street Fighter 6 bracket has no confirmed Capcom Pro Tour designation or associated qualification reward announced in the available event details.

Beyond Street Fighter 6

TGU 2026 features an extensive main tournament lineup, including TEKKEN 8 as a Tekken World Tour Master event, Guilty Gear -Strive- as an ARC World Tour Gold+ Event, and Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising as a GBVS World Tour five star event. Other featured games include 2XKO, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, and Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Additional community brackets span classic and modern fighting games, including Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3, Dragon Ball FighterZ, and BlazBlue: Central Fiction. The wider program includes casual play, bring your own console setups, workshops, retro games and toys, artist and vendor areas, and an after party. Competitors register through start.gg, with individual tournament entry fees listed separately from the event pass.

midwest-mixfest-26.name: Midwest Mixfest 2026
midwest-mixfest-26.location: 411 Minnesota St, St Paul, MN 55101, USA
midwest-mixfest-26.description:
Recognized by its organizers as the largest fighting game tournament in the upper Midwest, Midwest Mixfest 2026 brings Minnesota's fighting game community together for three days of competition and side events. Organized by RunTheMix, which has supported the regional offline scene since 2018, the event returns with a new venue and an expanded lineup of 18 tournament brackets. Street Fighter 6 anchors the competitive program alongside a broad selection of modern and classic fighting games.

The Street Fighter 6 tournament is part of the main bracket schedule across Saturday and Sunday. Friday features exhibitions, casual matches, and RunTheGauntlet, a signature event format. No confirmed Capcom Pro Tour designation or qualification reward has been announced for the Street Fighter 6 bracket. Competitors can register through start.gg, with the main tournaments complemented by free play stations and a dedicated bring your own controller and console area.

Games and Community Events

Midwest Mixfest features 18 brackets across a varied lineup of fighting games, including TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, Melty Blood: Type Lumina, Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes, and 2XKO. The broader program also includes classic fighting games, casual play, exhibitions, and community gatherings. A regional qualifying series called Road to Mixfest offers selected tournament winners free event admission and hotel accommodation, extending the event's reach beyond the Twin Cities. The weekend emphasizes both bracket competition and opportunities for players to connect with the wider Midwest FGC.

battle-coliseum-2026.name: Battle Coliseum 2026
battle-coliseum-2026.location: Av. Manuel Bandeira, 360, Vila Leopoldina, São Paulo, SP 05317-020, Brazil
battle-coliseum-2026.description:
Organized by Fighting Games Club SP, Battle Coliseum 2026 builds on a Brazilian tournament series that brought together regional competitors and international players for its 2025 edition. Returning to São Paulo, the event features an expanded multi-game program spanning established fighting game franchises and newer competitive releases. Street Fighter 6 remains part of the main tournament lineup, bringing Brazil's competitive scene together with players from across the region.

The Street Fighter 6 tournament uses a double elimination format, with matches played on PC. Sets are best of three games through the early rounds, with the top eight moving to best of five. No Capcom Pro Tour designation or associated qualification reward is confirmed for this edition.

Multi-Game Competition

The wider lineup includes TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, 2XKO, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, Mortal Kombat 1, The King of Fighters XV, Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, and Brawlhalla. Several brackets carry external circuit designations, including an Arc World Tour Platinum event for Guilty Gear -Strive- and a five star World Tour event for Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising. The schedule also includes the Brazilian Mortal Kombat 1 championship finals and an open Mortal Kombat 1 tournament with a listed prize pool. Competitors register through start.gg, where event details and tournament rules are published.

drowning-pools-2026.name: Drowning Pools 2026
drowning-pools-2026.location: Metropolitan Cathedral, Brownlow Hill, Liverpool L3 5TQ, UK
drowning-pools-2026.description:
Drowning Pools 2026 brings the Merseyside FGC community together for a day of fighting game competition in Liverpool, with Street Fighter 6 featured alongside a wider multi-game lineup.

Registration and the latest information are available on the official Start.gg event page.

evo-singapore-2027.name: Evo Singapore 2027
evo-singapore-2027.venueName: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
evo-singapore-2027.description:
Evo Singapore 2027 marks the first Southeast Asian expansion in the history of the world's longest-running fighting game festival, establishing an unprecedented international milestone for the series. The debut connects decades of open-bracket heritage to the Pacific. Street Fighter 6 headlines the competition as the centerpiece attraction, drawing contenders worldwide to vie for premier championship honors.

Contenders battle through open double-elimination pools where tournament survival dictates international hierarchy. The flagship bracket awards a primary cut of the event's guaranteed US$125,000 multi-game purse, demanding peak execution across three intense days of pool play and finals.

Tournament Lineup and World Tour Finals

Four additional main titles share the arena floor: Tekken 8, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, Guilty Gear -Strive-, and Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising. Running alongside the open brackets, the venue simultaneously hosts the Tekken World Tour 2026 Global Finals, complete with a Last Chance Qualifier and an independent US$300,000 circuit purse.

Convention Experience and Logistics

Attendees can explore an expansive arcade zone filled with cabinets from around the globe, an official museum installation tracing competitive fighting game history, publisher booths, and community-run side tournaments. Competitor and spectator admission passes are secured through Trip.com, with separate tournament bracket enrollment processed via start.gg.

frosty-faustings-xix-2027.name: Frosty Faustings XIX 2027
frosty-faustings-xix-2027.description:
Entering its 19th year, Frosty Faustings XIX 2027 continues one of North America's established four-day celebrations of open-bracket fighting games. The event drew approximately 4,400 attendees in 2026 and returns with more than 30 featured main-game tournaments, alongside a substantial community-run program. With roots in the Guilty Gear scene and a broad anime fighting game lineup, Frosty Faustings brings legacy titles and current competitive releases together under one roof.

Street Fighter 6 is part of the main singles competition, with a separate 2v2 Waseda team tournament scheduled for Thursday. The published program does not list a Capcom Pro Tour designation for the SF6 brackets. General tournament rules specify double elimination, with most matches played best of three and winners, losers, and grand finals played best of five. Competitors register through start.gg and should check in for their pools before the scheduled start time.

Multi-Game Competition and Community Events

The main lineup includes Guilty Gear -Strive-, an Arc World Tour Platinum qualifier, as well as Tekken 8, 2XKO, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, and numerous other modern and classic fighters. Beyond the main brackets, Vortex Gallery hosts dozens of community tournaments. The four-day program also includes special exhibitions, team events, an arcade and casual play spaces, fighting game vendors and artists, a cosplay contest, and nightly karaoke. The venue operates around the clock for the event, giving competitors and spectators room to play and socialize between scheduled matches.

genesis-x4.name: Genesis X4 2027
genesis-x4.location: 150 W San Carlos St, San Jose, CA 95113, USA
genesis-x4.description:
Genesis X4 represents the fourteenth major iteration in one of the longest-running tournament traditions in esports history, tracing its grassroots lineage back to Northern California in 2009. While the festival established its enduring legacy through the pinnacle stages of Super Smash Bros. Melee and Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, modern editions have broadened their scope to embrace the wider fighting game scene. That evolution places Street Fighter 6 in a prominent co-headline role, drawing elite challengers into open double-elimination brackets where legacy meets modern fighting game mastery.

Competitors entering the Street Fighter 6 arena face rigorous pool play transitioning into high-pressure finals stages, requiring sharp execution across every match. The tournament provides an essential proving ground on the winter competitive calendar, where victory demands navigating deep brackets packed with top regional and international talent. Alongside Capcom's flagship title, premier competitions for Super Smash Bros. Melee and Super Smash Bros. Ultimate command dedicated championship stages, preserving the series' foundational heritage while crowning world-class champions.

Tournament Roster and Side Competitions

The competitive lineup extends well beyond the headlining titles, presenting brackets for Tekken 8, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, 2XKO, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, and Rivals of Aether II. Classic retro titles and dedicated dance rhythm brackets round out the competition schedule throughout the weekend.

Convention Floor and Registration Logistics

Following a previous edition that welcomed more than 3,400 attendees, the event offers uninterrupted twenty-four-hour venue access across its expansive exhibition halls. The floor houses an artist alley, dedicated tabletop gaming, open Riichi Mahjong, trading card brackets, and an extensive free-play arcade. Competitor and spectator badges are secured online, with tournament registration managed through start.gg.

texas-showdown-2027.name: Texas Showdown 2027
texas-showdown-2027.location: 2001 Post Oak Blvd, Houston, TX 77056, USA
texas-showdown-2027.venueName: Hilton Houston Post Oak by the Galleria
texas-showdown-2027.description:
Texas Showdown 2027 represents more than two decades of competitive fighting game heritage, maintaining its standing as the longest-running annual tournament in Texas and one of the oldest active grassroots gatherings in North America. Tracing its lineage back to the arcade scene of 2000, the championship weekend continues its tradition of uniting regional southern talent with premier international competition. Street Fighter 6 headlines the main stage as the primary open bracket, setting the tone for the entire multi-game weekend.

Entrants navigating the Street Fighter 6 pools must endure unforgiving double-elimination brackets that reward matchup adaptability and execution under pressure. Advancing into the final phases demands composure against a diverse field representing both seasoned veterans and rising regional competitors. Bracket triumph delivers crucial competitive prestige on the spring tournament calendar while establishing regional supremacy in the heart of Texas.

Tournament Roster and Legacy Brackets

The competitive schedule features an extensive slate of modern and classic fighting titles running alongside the flagship bracket. Main tournaments include Tekken 8, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, Guilty Gear -Strive-, 2XKO, Mortal Kombat 1, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, and Dragon Ball FighterZ. Dedicated legacy tournaments celebrate fighting game history through classic brackets for Capcom vs. SNK 2, Super Street Fighter II Turbo, Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike, and the annual Ultra Street Fighter IV memorial bracket.

Convention Floor and Registration Logistics

Following a 2026 gathering that drew over 1,200 attendees, the event floor pairs open competition with community-driven side tournaments, an artist alley showcasing independent creators, and dedicated vendor spaces. Competitor passes and spectator badges are managed online through the official portal, with all open tournament bracket registration conducted directly via start.gg.
